description: 방송미디어통신위원회_스마트폰_PC시청기록조사 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 스마트폰, PC의 방송프로그램별 월 시청시간, 장르별 월 시청시간에 대한 통계정보. 스마트폰과 PC를 이용해 시청하는 방송프로그램의 장르별, 프로그램별 월시청시간을 성별, 연령별로 구분하여 제공함. 방송프로그램의 장르는 교육, 드라마&영화, 보도, 스포츠, 어린이(유아), 오락, 정보, 기타 로 구분함.... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are 핸드폰, PC, 시청자조사, 시청시간, 프로그램. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
